mapper.select: INSERT INTO t_group (user_id, name, sort_order) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{sortOrder}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, name) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL DO NOTHING RETURNING id
SELECT id, name, sort_order AS sortOrder, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM t_group WHERE id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

WITH conflict AS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_group WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND name = #{name} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND id <> #{groupId} ), updated AS ( UPDATE t_group SET name = #{name}, sort_order = COALESCE(#{sortOrder,jdbcType=INTEGER}, sort_order), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conflict) RETURNING id ) SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conflict) THEN 0 WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

WITH removed AS ( UPDATE t_group SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id ), detached AS ( UPDATE t_link SET group_id = NULL, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND created_by_user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM removed) RETURNING id ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM removed
